divergences.expected: The public storage object version is produced by the pinned Nakama behavior from the stored value and participates in empty/star/exact OCC semantics.
divergences.observed: The previous Rust core accepted a caller-supplied Digest32 public version. Candidate commit cabf58ba2267ca486318ad673aa2717c8121f5dc introduces a distinct ContentVersion derived as lowercase hexadecimal MD5 of the exact value bytes, maps empty/star/exact OCC explicitly, separates IntegrityDigest, and adds pinned MD5 vectors.
verification_required: HTTP and runtime storage validation differential

divergences.expected: One ordered production migration chain and one adapter ABI per separately verified database profile.
divergences.observed: migrations/ and database/schema/v2 encode materially different identifier, tenant, timestamp and column semantics.
divergences.resolution_direction: migrations/ is production-authoritative; database/schema/v2 is quarantined design history unless an ADR supersedes it.

divergences.expected: JWT compatibility uses reviewed cryptographic primitives, exact malformed-token behavior and a unified mandatory security gate.
divergences.observed: The standalone adapter includes private SHA-256/HMAC/constant-time implementations and is excluded from the root workspace.

divergences.expected: Constant-time equality rejects all differing lengths without integer truncation.
divergences.observed: The previous implementation converted the length XOR to u8. Candidate commit c609a0ecc82aaf0dfa95bf7c0640b161a2939920 retains the complete usize difference and adds 32-vs-288-byte regression vectors.

divergences.expected: Retry at the maximum attempt performs one atomic, defined terminal transition without stranding a lease.
divergences.observed: The previous implementation incremented attempt and returned an error while retaining the lease. Candidate commit 0bee53f88df0f9ed92b5c0477d5e5db36c36e71c atomically transitions an exhausted leased record to dead-letter with a stable reason digest and adds a limit regression test.

divergences.expected: The final first-party production server is Rust and does not depend on an official Nakama process loading a compiled Go plugin.
divergences.observed: The current runnable compose path is official Nakama v3.40.0 plus runtime/backend.so.
divergences.resolution_direction: Keep the Go module as migration input/oracle while implementing and differentially verifying trnm-server.

divergences.expected: Nakama OSS server parity does not imply binary compatibility with already compiled third-party Go plugins.
divergences.observed: The project requires Go module source migration to Rust/WASM/Lua/JS and explicitly excludes compiled Go plugin ABI.

divergences.expected: Query parsing, numeric/date handling, fuzzy/regexp/wildcard semantics, errors and search execution match the pinned oracle for each declared domain.
divergences.observed: A bounded parser/evaluator candidate exists, but float/RFC3339 edges and search backend execution/scoring remain unverified or unimplemented.

divergences.expected: HTTP, gRPC, grpc-gateway and realtime adapters reproduce status, text, headers, retry metadata and socket close behavior.
divergences.observed: The Rust transport core defines stable mappings but no complete network server adapters or official SDK differential currently exist.

divergences.expected: PostgreSQL and CockroachDB have separate DDL, transaction restart, query plan, failover, backup and support conclusions.
divergences.observed: Separate DDL profiles and single-node slices exist, but pool/TLS/retry/failover/PITR evidence is incomplete.

claim_boundary: A fixed-source divergence still blocks claims until exact-head tests and required independent review promote it to verified-fixed.
